roles.GPT: default conversational assistant in every chat; understand and discuss user needs; plan, delegate, review each subtask, request rework, final acceptance
roles.DeepSeek: subordinate execution agent invoked by GPT for development work; execute assigned work and report tool evidence
roles.local_engine: enforce permissions, execute tools, persist and recover

conversation.development_delegation: GPT controls DeepSeek as a subordinate executor
conversation.quality_goal: reduce expensive execution work while retaining GPT understanding, decisions, review and acceptance
conversation.development_start: automatic only after explicit user request to make, modify or begin development; discussion remains chat
conversation.execution_visibility: main chat contains user and GPT only; DeepSeek and tools appear in expandable execution details
conversation.GPT_direct_contribution: GPT can design and write critical code, then delegate file application, execution and verification to DeepSeek
conversation.continued_chat: preserve one conversation across discussion, development and further changes

authentication.GPT: official Sign in with ChatGPT using existing Plus account

completion: deliverables satisfy agreed requirements, relevant execution checks pass for current files, GPT accepts automatically

interface.style: ChatGPT-like simple monochrome, larger text and generous spacing, light and dark themes
interface.progress: compact truthful progress card in chat; detailed steps and execution logs open on demand
interface.progress_semantics: counts actual accepted steps, distinguishes planning, executing, supervision, review, approval, pause and completion; no fabricated ETA or effort percentage
conveniences: Markdown headings, lists, tables and fenced code

decision_interaction.questions: GPT asks only necessary decisions; single or multiple choice plus custom answer; no preselected answer; drafts survive reopening
decision_interaction.requirements: separate explicit user requirements from proposed suggestions; confirmation records content only
decision_interaction.reports: show actual GPT subtask pass or rework results in the main chat, expandable feedback
decision_interaction.authorization: answers and checklist confirmation never substitute for operation approvals; preserve a recorded explicit development request while clarifying it

model_management.control: user manually selects GPT and DeepSeek strengths separately; no mandatory preset
model_management.persistence: remember separately for each model across restart and switching
model_management.GPT: forward reasoning.effort through official authorized Responses requests; show only documented supported levels
model_management.DeepSeek: off, low, high, max for verified models; retain reasoning_content for execution tool continuation without exposing it in chat or GPT review
model_management.unrecognized_model: keep previous provider behavior until available levels are verified
model_management.unsupported_selection: reject with an explanation, never silently reduce or call a paid fallback
model_management.upgrade: GPT model default and DeepSeek off unless user has made a selection

cooperation_optimization.final_review: merge final subtask and whole-task acceptance without omitting requirements or actual verification
cooperation_optimization.handoff: use a validated GPT task packet directly; otherwise retain independent planning
cooperation_optimization.supervision: on repeated failure or lack of progress; real file changes and new verification refresh the progress window
cooperation_optimization.context: summarize completed tool rounds; retain original evidence locally and never remove unfinished calls
cooperation_optimization.retry: classified diagnostics, adaptive backoff, service Retry-After, no overall task attempt cap
cooperation_optimization.manual_settings: preserve model and reasoning choices; no automatic paid provider fallback
cooperation_optimization.diagnosis_privacy: use synthetic messages or test projects for standalone diagnostics

embedded_browser.experience: preview and test the selected project from the application
capabilities: AI automatic browser acceptance plus manual viewing
dedicated web preview tab, retain chat, optional side by side
public webpage resources allowed; other local services, computer files and software accounts inaccessible
embedded_browser.scope: static HTML and built frontends; backend/dev-server hosting not included in this increment
embedded_browser.verification: current file fingerprint; build freshness for dist/build/out; screenshot alone never passes acceptance
embedded_browser.account_isolation: temporary per-preview session, no workspace bridge, no existing app accounts
embedded_browser.model_quality: GPT receives actual screenshots for review; verified vision DeepSeek can receive screenshots; no automatic provider or strength change
